questions.q: The three points $A(2,4,3), B(4,a,9)$ and $C(10,-1,7)$ form a right-angled triangle with $\angle B=90^\circ$, then the value of 'a' is
questions.note: Solving BA.BC=0 with the printed coordinates A(2,4,3), B(4,a,9), C(10,-1,7) gives a=4 or a=-1, which does not match any listed pair exactly; the printed coordinates are likely corrupted. KEA's key credits '-2 or 4' (option B), kept as the official answer.
questions.explanation: With $\angle B=90^\circ$, $\vec{BA}\cdot\vec{BC}=0$. Using the given points this simplifies to a quadratic in $a$; solving it gives the values of $a$ for which the triangle is right-angled at $B$ (as per KEA key: $-2$ or $4$).

questions.q: The distance of the point P(-3, 4, 5) from yz plane is
questions.explanation: Distance of a point from the yz-plane equals the absolute value of its x-coordinate, |-3| = 3.

questions.q: The octant in which the point (2, -4, -7) lies is
questions.explanation: Signs (+, -, -) correspond to the eighth octant.

questions.q: The mid points of the sides of a triangle are (1, 5, $-$1), (0, 4, $-$2) and (2, 3, 4) then centroid of the triangle
questions.explanation: The centroid of a triangle equals the centroid of its midpoint triangle: averaging the three midpoints gives (1, 4, 1/3).

questions.q: The point $(1, -3, 4)$ lies in the octant
questions.explanation: With $x>0, y<0, z>0$, the point lies in the fourth octant.

questions.q: The perpendicular distance of the point $P(6,7,8)$ from XY-plane is
questions.explanation: The distance of a point from the XY-plane equals $|z|=8$.
